name: Toy chatbot with OpenCode and GLM 5.3

mentions.name: Toy chatbot with OpenCode and GLM 5.3
mentions.description: This is a toy chatbot being built by vibe coding with OpenCode and the GLM 5.3 model, using open weights models and AI SWE tools like Mastra, LangSmith, and DeepInfra along the way. It will be open-sourced once meaningfully complete, after the repo is checked for secrets.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm vibe coding a toy chatbot with OpenCode and GLM 5.3 - I'll open source it once it's meaningfully done (keeping the repo private for now until I am _so so_ sure there are no secrets in it!)
mentions.author: alex-moon
